by_name.Glass Lancet: %user lifts one finger. A lancet of glass finds %target, and each one steadies her hand for the next.
by_name.The Glass Remembers: Every pane in the hall turns toward you at once. You have lingered too long in her house.
by_name.Refraction: "Hold still. I want to see you in the light." Light runs in from the walls. Light that bright never stays whole for long.
by_name.Far Refraction: "Turn. I haven't seen this side of you." Light runs in from the far walls, just as brittle.
by_name.Facet: "Every line has a reflection." Each line is drawn again across the hall. The gaps between them are all there is.
by_name.Refraction Breaks: The lines shatter where they lie. Wounds taken on the shards close slowly.
by_name.Far Refraction Breaks: The far lines shatter where they lie. Nothing standing in the shards mends well.
by_name.Facet Breaks: Both images shatter at once, and the floor stays jagged where they broke.
by_name.Lucid Refraction: "I can see it clearly now." The lines shatter, and new ones already lie where the light falls.
by_name.Lucid: The hall is suddenly very loud. %user straightens. "I can hear myself again." Her glass cuts deeper.
by_name.Your Likeness: "Hold still. There. That is you." Your likeness steps out of the glass, thin as an impression.
by_name.Your Own Strike: %user strikes exactly the way you would, straight through the guard you trust.
by_name.The Hush: Somewhere on the floor, sound stops. Nothing standing in the quiet will mend.
by_name.The Listening: Something under the floor turns toward the sound of you. While it lives, the deep holds her.
by_name.The Listening, Unbridled: It no longer waits to hear you. Another feeler rises, and the deep tightens its hold on her.
by_name.Stillness: The floor around the Silence goes still. Close to her, nothing moves for long.
by_name.Nothing Moves: For a moment nothing near the Silence moves. Nothing can, until something clean washes it off.
by_name.Cradle: The deep closes around %target. Blows slide off the glass while any feeler lives.
by_name.Grasp: %user closes around %target without a sound. The floor beneath does not wait.
by_name.Etching: Rime: %user traces the north of the hall into the glass. It rimes over and fades, but the glass forgets nothing.
by_name.Etching: Ember: %user traces the south of the hall into the glass. It fades from sight, not from the glass.
by_name.Etching: Seam: %user traces a seam down the west wall. It sinks into the glass the way a scar keeps a cut.
by_name.Etching: Heart: %user traces the heart of the hall into the glass. It beats once and fades; the glass keeps the rhythm.
by_name.Etching: Hail: %user taps a scatter of points into the glass, like hail. Each fades exactly where it fell.
by_name.Recast: Rime: The glass remembers the rime, and the north of the hall breaks. For a breath, her guard hangs open.
by_name.Recast: Ember: The glass remembers the ember, and the south of the hall breaks. For a breath, her guard hangs open.
by_name.Recast: Seam: The glass remembers the seam, and the west wall breaks. For a breath, her guard hangs open.
by_name.Recast: Heart: The glass remembers the heart, and the middle of the hall breaks. For a breath, her guard hangs open.
by_name.Recast: Hail: The glass remembers every point of hail, and all of them break at once. For a breath, her guard hangs open.
by_name.The Hush Rises: The floor stops making sound in patches. More rise each time she draws, and they never close.
by_name.The Glass Falls Quiet: %user lowers her hand. "Again." The hall rests, and something worn steps out of the glass.
by_name.Raise the Gate Porter: The gate porter steps out of the glass, still holding a door that is not there. He clears his threshold of anyone too near.
by_name.Raise Sister Hana: Sister Hana steps out of the glass, hands already busy. She will mend Sayo until someone stops her.
by_name.Raise Cadet Tomo: Cadet Tomo steps out of the glass, rope in hand. His line reaches a long way.
by_name.Doorward Sweep: "Gate's closed." %user sweeps the threshold clear, onto whatever floor lay behind.
by_name.Worn Mending: "Hold still, it's nearly done." %user tends to %target. She will not stop on her own.
by_name.Cadet's Tether: "Line's secure!" %user hauls %target in, over whatever floor lies between.
by_name.The Quiet: %user closes her eyes, and you go quiet with her. Each time, a little less of you mends.
by_name.Shatterfall: Cracks fan out from %user's feet. No one standing in the fan has walked out of the fall.
by_name.The Names Flood In: Every name in the glass floods the hall. Only where the three refused stays dry.
by_name.No One Is Mended: "Nothing mends here. Nothing needs to." The quiet covers the floor. What you carried in is all you have.
by_name.The Held Breath: %user breathes in. The air leaves the hall, except where the three refused. It will have to come out again.
by_name.Hush Where They Refused: The quiet seeps into one of the places where the three refused. Two remain.
by_name.Glassfall: First Pane: A third of the ceiling comes down where it was marked, and the next pane cracks.
by_name.Glassfall: Second Pane: Another marked third comes down, and the next pane cracks.
by_name.Glassfall: Last Pane: The last third comes down, and the first pane cracks again. The fall goes round like a clock.
by_name.Glassfall: Opening Pane: The second third comes down first, and the last pane cracks. The marks stay honest even when the order does not.
by_name.Glassfall: Heart Recast: The ceiling comes down, and the glass remembers the heart from the Stilling.

act3v2_by_id.moe-saint-refraction: Lines of black glass run in from the walls. She no longer pauses between one line and the next.
act3v2_by_id.moe-saint-facet: "Every line has a reflection." Both images are drawn at once; the floor between them is all there is.
act3v2_by_id.moe-saint-hold-still: "Hold still." The glass either side of %target goes quiet. It minds where you would go, not where you are.
act3v2_by_id.moe-saint-the-silence-holds-her: The Silence folds around %user. Blows slide off and feed it. One clean break would shatter it.
act3v2_by_id.moe-saint-remainder-lancet: %user flicks a lancet of black glass at %target. Each one steadies her hand for the next.
act3v2_by_id.moe-saint-hush-rises: The floor stops making sound in patches. Nothing mends in them.
act3v2_by_id.moe-saint-hush-where-they-refused: The quiet seeps into one of the places where the three refused. Two remain.
act3v2_by_id.moe-saint-every-line: "Hold still." A line of glass runs through %target. It bears one who stays, not one who walks along it.
